correctness.rationale: The dimension bound follows from an exact block form, a sharp scalar optimization, and complete-pivot row/column norm constraints; an explicit unique-largest-pivot family asymptotically attains the square-matrix constant.

originality.rationale: Checked ACA and complete-pivot sources analyze geometric rank-one effects, max-entry growth, or global approximation error. No prior sharp one-step Frobenius residual factor equivalent to sqrt(nm/(n+m-1)) was located; the claim is restricted to that source-specific quantitative obstruction and its sharp construction.

value.rationale: The theorem shows that choosing the unique largest residual entry can still increase Frobenius error by order sqrt(N) in one step, sharply quantifying a local failure mode of greedy ACA and separating it from monotone PSD diagonal pivoting.
